arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. After the hard start, settle to shaft power near sustainable_shaft_power_w (about 150-160 W; pod CP 152 W, may be 10-25 pct off). Spend the pod reserve evenly; keep w_bal_pod_frac above about 0.3 until 2 km to go, then lift gradually; final sprint (finish cue) at about 400 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for incidents: drag jump (weed/rudder) = push_local minus push_along falls while pod power steady; pod drift = boat power / shaft power ratio shifts while GPS speed steady; radio messages (course change -> set_race_distance and tell). Compare same-direction legs with legs().

Test: if reserve hits ~5 pct and speed at same rate does not fade (fade_pct, cp_implied_w), raise CP via set_critical_power; if fade appears, ease to ~150 W.

Paddler now 6/10 feeling good, could go harder, while model reserve 9 pct pod / 6 pct boat; fade only -0.5 pct; eff_ratio steady 0.62-0.66. Evidence CP may be underestimated. Running the test: no cue, let them hold ~160 W; watches fade_drop (fade<-3) and model_empty (reserve<5 pct 75 s). If model empty and no fade -> raise CP (try cp_shaft ~165-170).

arguments.text: Not yet. Hold this exact pace, your push comes later.
8.0 min: paddler said feeling great, going harder (unprompted). Model reserve 8 pct pod at 160 W. Cued hold to block a surge until CP test answers (model empty + no fade = raise CP).

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to surge with model reserve at 8 pct; wait for the CP test before allowing more.

arguments.text: Ease slightly. Relaxed and steady, this is your race pace.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Reserve spent by the hard start (model ~0 at 9 min); CP 152 W shaft looks right (fade grew to -2 pct while pod power slid 164->156 W, eff_ratio steady ~0.64, so not drag or current). Paddler is overconfident (says feeling great): do not let them surge. Hold shaft ~148-152 W (boat ~97-99 W) through the middle; no pushes. Final sprint (finish cue) at ~400 m to go, maybe a lift at ~1000 m if pod reserve has rebuilt above ~25 pct. Watch for incidents: drag jump (drag_anom falls with pod power steady -> clear_rudder if weed), pod drift (eff_ratio shifts with GPS speed steady), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell).

9.2 min: CP test answered: model empty and fade -2.1 pct with pod power sliding to 156 W; eff_ratio 0.64 unchanged so the fade is the paddler, not drag/current. Keep CP as calibrated. Cued ease toward ~150 W.

text: Cued ease to ~150 W: model reserve empty and fade growing to -2 pct, so calibrated CP stands; paddler is overconfident.

arguments.text: 12.2 min: holding 155 W shaft, fade steady ~-2 pct, pod reserve 2 pct, boat reserve 0. Not forced down yet. If they keep 155 W past pod-empty without fade worsening, CP may be ~155; if forced down, CP confirmed. Watches power_drop (<138 W) and surge (>170 W) added.

arguments.message: boat-model power well below CP: forced down (reserve empty), weed or drag, or current misfit

arguments.text: 14.6 min POD DRIFT: pod power ramped 158->186 W from 13.6 min (started on leg 2, GPS speed unchanged 2.72), boat power unchanged 103 W, rate same, paddler 5/10 all good. Pod reads high: ignore shaft_power, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local, drag_anom. Use boat power_w, speed_water, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct. Removed pod watches; added boat_drop (power_w<92). Raised boat CP 99->105 on evidence of no forced drop after model empty.
Lift a little now. Strong, smooth, hold 2:35 pace.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. POD DRIFTS HIGH from 13.6 min: ignore shaft_power, pod reserve, push_local; steer by boat power_w, speed_water, reserve_left_pct (boat), fade_pct. Boat CP raised 99->105 W at 14.6 min (no forced drop after model empty, effort ratings falling). Target boat power ~106-108 W = water speed ~3.0 m/s: over the ground ~155 s/500 on out legs (current +0.22), ~180 s/500 on back legs (current -0.23). Re-cue pace after each turn. If boat_drop alarm (forced down) -> ease, CP was right; if reserve_left_pct stays >40 and no fade, consider cp 110. Final sprint (finish cue) at ~400 m to go; lift at ~1500 m if boat reserve >30 pct. Incidents: weed = speed_water and fade drop at same effort -> clear_rudder; radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

text: Pod drifting high (power up, speed unchanged, effort 5/10): switched to boat-side numbers, raised boat CP to 105 W, cued a modest push to 2:35 pace.

arguments.text: 15.6 min WEED LIKELY: paddler said boat feels heavy all of a sudden, something on the rudder? Pod power 218 W (up from 158 since 13.6 min) while speed_water stuck 2.97 and boat power 103 W: extra effort going into drag, so pod is probably TRUE, not drifting (earlier pod-drift note likely wrong). ACTION at next wake: cue clear_rudder at once (gate was 11 s away). Then check: pod power back near 160 W at same speed, or speed up at same pod power = cleared. Paddler real effort above shaft CP since 13.6 min: risk of blow-up, ease after clearing.

arguments.text: 16.6 min: clear_rudder done at 15.9 min (back-stroke seen, speed dip 33 pct, GPS 30-s mean 3.19 -> 2.96 at 982 s, recovering 3.13 at 997 s). Pod still ~210 W. Judge by ~1030 s: if GPS on this out leg rises well above 3.2 (toward 3.4) at same pod power -> weed cleared, then ease pod toward ~160-170 W; if GPS back at ~3.2 with pod 210 -> weed still on (clear again) or pod reads high. fade_pct alarm -6.6 is mostly the back-stroke dip.

17.4 min: after clear_rudder GPS back to 3.25 at 2:34 pace with pod still 215 W and paddler only 4/10 feeling good: POD READS HIGH (drift), ignore pod. Effort falling 7-6-5-4 while boat power held 100-110 W -> raised boat CP to 110 (2nd of 3 uses) and cued push to 2:31 over ground (boat ~114 W, water ~3.08). Back legs: water 3.08 -> GPS ~2.85 -> ~175 s/500. Guard: boat_drop watch (power_w < 92) = forced down -> ease and lower CP.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. POD READS HIGH since 13.6 min (pod 215 W while paddler 4/10 and boat speed unchanged): ignore shaft_power, pod reserve, push_local. Steer by boat power_w, speed_water, reserve_left_pct (boat), fade_pct, paddler effort. Rudder cleared at 15.9 min after paddler felt a heavy boat. Boat CP raised 99->105->110 W (1 change left) on evidence: no forced drop, effort falling. Target boat ~112-116 W, water ~3.08 m/s: over the ground ~151 s/500 on out legs (current +0.22), ~175 s/500 on back legs (current -0.23). Re-cue pace after each turn (turns at 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500, 8750 m). If boat_drop alarm or fade < -3 without a turn/back-stroke -> ease, lower CP. Lift at ~1500 m to go if boat reserve > 40 pct; finish cue at ~400 m. Weed again (heavy boat, speed down at same effort) -> clear_rudder. Radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.
